title: fix(runtime): the personal-view and attachment own-door 501s follow the request's language, like the print door's
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPE7uyDAJyqjwwMzomWv5ff)_

Fixes #37352

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (no page under `skills/**` names the own-door bridge or its `501` sentences)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在缺少个人视图服务或附件服务的环境里，删除个人视图、删除或重命名附件时弹出的「接口不可用」提示，现在和打印一样按界面语言（中文、日文、西班牙文）显示；英文界面一字不差。
- 为什么做：同一个故障，打印接口已经显示中文，旁边这两个接口还显示整句英文，用户看到的语言取决于点了哪个按钮。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某种语言措辞不够好；错误码、状态码和服务名都不变，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: the operation-message catalog (`BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES`) gains the two doors' nouns, `own_door_personal_view_delete` and `own_door_attachment_mutate`, in `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`. The English of each is the bridge's current `noun`, byte for byte. The catalog header names all three noun keys.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/personal-views.ts`, `attachments.ts`: each bridge sets `nounKey`, as `print.ts` does since #37336, so `notImplementedSentence` renders both `501` sentences (`own_door_service_unregistered`, `own_door_member_missing`) in the request's top `Accept-Language` tag.
- No wire change: code `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, status `501`, the slot, member and package names are unchanged, and no `userMessage` is added.

Small calls made here (no card): the Spanish attachment noun is singular (`el punto de acceso para eliminar y renombrar adjuntos`) so the catalog's singular `no está disponible` agrees with it; the English keeps its existing plural noun with `is`, since it must stay byte-identical.

## Why

After #37336 the print door answered its own-door `501` in the reader's language while the two sibling doors on the same bridge answered in English, so one failure mode read in two languages depending on the door.

## Verification

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts`, new describe `[#37352]`: for both doors (personal-view `DELETE`; attachment `DELETE` and `PATCH`), on a kernel with no service and with a service lacking its member, the `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` message is pinned in `en` (and with no header), `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`, with no `userMessage`; the catalog English of all three noun keys equals each bridge's `noun`. Red first: with `nounKey` removed from the personal-view bridge, 3 of the 50 tests fail.
- The `#37273` control "a bridge that names no noun key keeps its English sentence" now takes a shipped bridge with its key removed and hands it to `handleOwnDoorBridgeRequest` directly, since no shipped bridge lacks one any more.
- Local runs at `9a610dc71`: `@objectstack/runtime` vitest `src/domains` 240 files / 7,024 tests pass; `@objectstack/spec` vitest `src/system` 78 files / 2,787 pass; `@objectstack/core` `operation-user-message.test.ts` 9/9; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0; eslint on the touched files exit 0; `tsc --noEmit` for runtime exit 0; `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exit 0.

Contract review (L2) is owed before landing: the diff changes `packages/spec/src/**` and declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (`check:generated` reports nothing to regenerate).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
